# falllegalpaper-sdk

> The FallLegalPaper template engine and its 15 document templates for SRA-regulated firms, plus 12 offline answers, as a JavaScript library. MIT, no dependencies, no network.

Live page: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/falllegalpaper-sdk/
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/falllegalpaper-sdk
Install: npm install github:sjgant80-hub/falllegalpaper-sdk
Product page: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/falllegalpaper/

## Exports

- TEMPLATES · templateById · templatesByArea: The 15 templates and lookups (an area's list includes the templates for every area).
- fieldsOf(template): Every {{path}} a template reads, in first-use order.
- buildContext({ client, matter, adviser, supervisor, firm, today, docRef, ctx }): A context in the shape the templates read; anything left out shows as a placeholder.
- renderHtml(template, ctx, overrides?): { html, missing }: the sections as HTML, and the required fields still empty.
- renderMarkdown(template, ctx, overrides?): The document as Markdown.
- standaloneHtml(html, title): A complete, printable HTML page.
- matchT0(question) · T0_RULES: The matching offline answer, or null; and the 12 answers.
- fillBody · fillBodyMd · mdToHtml · stripHtml · esc · toText · get · sec · sectionsHtml · sectionsMarkdown: The engine's parts, for building your own templates.

## Limits

- Templates are as at November 2026. Fees, thresholds and forms change: review before use.
- The offline answers are short summaries; the matcher can miss a question phrased differently.
- Overrides are inserted as HTML without escaping, by design (they are your own edited text). Do not pass untrusted HTML as an override.
- The section 21 template is a file note recording that the route has ended; it cannot produce a notice.
